question: Which animals can be carried as pets in the cabin?
gold_answer: Only dogs and cats are permitted as pets in the cabin (service animals - dogs only - and falcons are handled separately).

question: How old must a guest be to be allowed to travel with a pet in the cabin?
gold_answer: The guest must be at least 18 years old.

question: Can I take my dog in First class?
gold_answer: No. Pets are permitted in Economy and Business cabins only; not in First or The Residence.

question: How many pets are allowed in the cabin on an A321LR flight?
gold_answer: A maximum of 4 pets per flight, all in Economy.

question: Which SSR elements are used for APIS information?
gold_answer: DOCS (primary travel document), DOCO (secondary document, e.g. visa) and DOCA (address).

question: Will a passport showing only the month and year of birth, like JAN 80, be accepted for entry to the UAE?
gold_answer: No. Incomplete dates of birth such as Month/Year or Year only are not accepted; the full Day/Month/Year is required.

question: How can a pet in cabin be booked?
gold_answer: Pets in the cabin can only be booked through Etihad Contact Centres.
